__comment: Tag-65 Marathon-Dashboard-Kachel for Cutover-Day-Morgen-Verdict (Noa Bergstroem / SRE). Single-screen tile-cluster that the AR-Hand / Operator-Hand opens once per cutover-week morning to read the Selin Tag-64 Auto-Scheduler verdict (READY / CAUTION / BLOCK) plus its supporting context: window-days-remaining in the KW-24..27 cutover-window, last-update-timestamp of the verdict envelope, and the trinary recording-rule integer-class. Driven by the Tag-64 recording-rule wakir_cutover_day_morgen_verdict_class (0=READY, 1=CAUTION, 2=BLOCK) and three companion gauges that the Tag-65 helper tooling/ci/render_cutover_day_morgen_tile.py emits onto the Prometheus textfile-exporter surface: wakir_cutover_day_morgen_verdict_emitted_at_seconds (Unix-seconds of envelope emission), wakir_cutover_day_morgen_window_days_remaining (calendar-days remaining in the KW-24..27 window, -1 if outside the window), wakir_cutover_day_morgen_in_cutover_window (0/1 boolean). Six panels: (1) Verdict-stat (single big READY/CAUTION/BLOCK stat with RdYlGn colour-band), (2) Window-days-remaining gauge (countdown 0..28), (3) Last-update timestamp (UTC ISO, stale-after-1h coloured red), (4) Per-substrate readiness ladder (engine_composite + pyramide_composite + e2e_smoke, three sub-stats green/yellow/red), (5) Verdict-class history sparkline last 24h, (6) AR-Hand action-link panel (text-only, deep-links to the runbooks). Anchors: Selin Tag-64 PR #406 (Auto-Scheduler), Noa Tag-64 PR #410 (Trinary-Routing-Reactive-Wiring), ADR-0066 Phase-3c Cutover-Plan. Schema version Grafana 10.x (schemaVersion 38). Sole datasource UID 'prom' (Prometheus).
title: Wakir - Cutover-Day-Morgen Verdict Tile

panels.title: Cutover-Day-Morgen Verdict (trinary)
panels.__comment: The single primary read of this dashboard. Translates the integer-encoded recording-rule wakir_cutover_day_morgen_verdict_class (0=READY, 1=CAUTION, 2=BLOCK) into a coloured READY/CAUTION/BLOCK text-stat. Thresholds: 0 -> green (READY), 1 -> yellow (CAUTION), 2 -> red (BLOCK). Value-mappings transform the integer to the canonical CUTOVER-DAY-MORGEN-{READY,CAUTION,BLOCK} string from tooling/ci/aggregate_cutover_day_morgen_verdict.py. This panel is the at-a-glance check the AR-Hand makes at 06:30 CEST every cutover-week-morning.

panels.title: Window-Days-Remaining (KW-24..27)
panels.__comment: Calendar-days remaining in the KW-24..27 cutover-window. The helper tooling/ci/render_cutover_day_morgen_tile.py computes this from the envelope's window.iso_week + emitted_at_utc: if iso_week is in {24,25,26,27}, days_remaining = (last-Friday-of-window) - (today). If iso_week is None or outside the window, the helper emits -1 and this gauge reads 'out-of-window'. The KW-24..27 window covers 28 calendar days; the gauge maxes at 28 and counts down. AR-Hand watches this descend each morning as a confidence-marker that the marathon is on schedule.

panels.title: Last-Update Timestamp (UTC)
panels.__comment: Stale-detector. The helper tooling/ci/render_cutover_day_morgen_tile.py emits wakir_cutover_day_morgen_verdict_emitted_at_seconds as the Unix-seconds of the envelope's emitted_at_utc field. Grafana 'now() - <emitted_at_seconds>' yields the freshness-age in seconds. Thresholds: < 600s green (fresh, last cron-tick was within 10 min), < 3600s yellow (stale up to 1h, the cron-tick is at 06:00 UTC so up to 1h is normal mid-morning), >= 3600s red (the auto-scheduler missed a tick - operator-runbook §Stale-Verdict). Display: seconds-ago + the absolute UTC ISO timestamp via secondary text.

panels.title: Per-Substrate Readiness Ladder (engine / pyramide / e2e)
panels.__comment: Three sub-stats: engine_composite (Selin Tag-61/63 Persona-Engine Pre-Cutover-Final-Acceptance-Composite), pyramide_composite (Amara Tag-62 Pyramide-Acceptance Pre-Cutover Compositum), e2e_smoke (Amara Tag-63 Pre-Cutover-Final-Acceptance E2E-Smoke). Each substrate has its own integer-encoded class: 0=green, 1=yellow, 2=red. When the aggregate Cutover-Day-Morgen verdict is BLOCK or CAUTION, this panel tells the AR-Hand WHICH substrate degraded without opening the envelope.json.

panels.title: Verdict-Class History (last 24h)
panels.__comment: 24h sparkline of the verdict-class integer. Visual confirmation of stability: a flat green line at y=0 is the desired pre-cutover-week pattern. Any step-up from 0 to 1 (yellow CAUTION) or 0 to 2 (red BLOCK) is the trigger for AR-Hand attention. The Tag-64 cron runs daily at 06:00 UTC so the line is discretised to ~24 sample-points per panel-window; if the line shows fewer points than expected, the auto-scheduler missed cron-ticks (the panel-3 stale-detector confirms).

panels.title: AR-Hand Action Links
panels.__comment: Static text-panel with the three deep-links the AR-Hand needs after reading the verdict: (a) READY-runbook (no action; informational), (b) CAUTION-runbook (review which substrate degraded; SRE on-call ack within 10 min), (c) BLOCK-runbook (T0 trigger on hold; AR-Hand decision required). Mirrors the runbook_url annotations on the three trinary alerts in dashboards/phase-3-marathon-alerts.yaml (Tag-64).

options.content:
### Cutover-Day-Morgen Verdict Runbooks

* **READY (green)** -> [cutover-day-morgen-ready runbook](https://wakir-labs.example/runbooks/cutover-day-morgen-ready) -- AR-Hand may proceed with T0 operator-trigger at 05:00 UTC. No action required.
* **CAUTION (yellow)** -> [cutover-day-morgen-caution runbook](https://wakir-labs.example/runbooks/cutover-day-morgen-caution) -- One or more inputs drifted (not blocking). SRE on-call must acknowledge within 10 minutes; otherwise escalate to AR.
* **BLOCK (red)** -> [cutover-day-morgen-block runbook](https://wakir-labs.example/runbooks/cutover-day-morgen-block) -- T0 trigger held by Mira-Hand-Hold-Marker. AR-Hand decision required before T0 may fire.

**Envelope:** `out/cutover-day-morgen-verdict.json` (per the Tag-64 Auto-Scheduler workflow `.github/workflows/cutover-day-morgen-auto-scheduler.yml`).

**Recording rule:** `wakir_cutover_day_morgen_verdict_class` (0=READY, 1=CAUTION, 2=BLOCK).

**Window:** KW-24..27 (2026-06-08 .. 2026-07-03).
